sn44.7:1.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahāmoggallānena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn44.7:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca:
sn44.7:2.1: kinnu kho bho moggallāna, sassato lokoti?
sn44.7:2.4: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna, asassato lokoti?
sn44.7:2.7: kinnu kho bho moggallāna, antavā lokoti?
sn44.7:2.10: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna, anantavā lokoti?
sn44.7:2.13: kinnu kho bho moggallāna, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti?
sn44.7:2.16: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna, aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti?
sn44.7:2.19: kinnu kho bho moggallāna, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn44.7:2.22: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn44.7:2.25: kinnu kho moggallāna, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn44.7:2.27: “hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn44.7:2.28: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn44.7:2.30: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn44.7:3.1: ko nu kho bho moggallāna, hetu ko paccayo yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.7:3.2: “sassato lokoti vā, asassato lokoti vā antavā lokoti vā, anantavā lokoti vā, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vā, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti”vā?
sn44.7:3.3: ko pana bho moggallāna, hetu ko paccayo yena samaṇassa gotamassa evaṃ puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.7:3.4: “sassato lokotipi, asassato lokotipi, antavā lokotipi, anantavā lokotipi, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīrantipi, aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīrantipi, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipī”ti?
sn44.7:4.1: aññatitthiyā kho vaccha, paribbājakā cakkhuṃ: “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassanti. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn44.7:4.2: jivhaṃ: “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassanti. kāyaṃ …pe…
sn44.7:4.3: manaṃ: etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassanti.
sn44.7:4.4: tasmā aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.7:4.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti”vā.
sn44.7:4.7: tathāgato ca kho vaccha, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho cakkhuṃ: “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassati. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn44.7:4.8: jivhaṃ: “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassati. kāyaṃ …pe…
sn44.7:4.9: manaṃ: “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassati.
sn44.7:4.10: tasmā tathāgatassa evaṃ puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.7:4.12: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipī”ti.
sn44.7:5.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn44.7:5.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn44.7:5.3: kinnu kho bho gotama, sassato lokoti?
sn44.7:5.4: avyākataṃ kho etaṃ vaccha, mayā: “sassato loko”ti …pe…
sn44.7:5.5: kiṃ pana bho gotama, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn44.7:5.7: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn44.7:6.1: ko nu kho bho gotama hetu ko paccayo yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti;
sn44.7:6.3: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti”vā?
sn44.7:6.4: ko pana bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yena bhoto gotamassa evaṃ puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.7:7.1: aññatitthiyā kho vaccha, paribbājakā cakkhuṃ: “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attāti” samanupassanti. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn44.7:7.2: jivhaṃ: “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attāti” samanupassanti. kāyaṃ …pe…
sn44.7:7.3: manaṃ “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attāti” samanupassanti.
sn44.7:7.4: tasmā aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.7:7.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti”vā.
sn44.7:7.7: tathāgato ca kho vaccha, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho cakkhuṃ: “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassati. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn44.7:7.9: manaṃ: “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassati.
sn44.7:7.10: tasmā tathāgatassa evaṃ puṭṭhassa evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti:
sn44.7:7.11: “sassato lokotipi, asassato lokotipi, antavā lokotipi, anantavā lokotipi, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīrantipi, aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīrantipi, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipi neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇātipī”ti.
sn44.7:8.1: acchariyaṃ bho gotama, abbhutaṃ bho gotama,
sn44.7:8.2: yatra hi nāma satthussa ca atthenattho vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṃsandissati samessati na vihāyissati yadidaṃ aggapadasmiṃ.
sn44.7:8.3: idānāhaṃ bho gotama, samaṇaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ āpucchiṃ.
sn44.7:8.4: samaṇopi me moggallāno etehi padehi etehi vyañjanehi etamatthaṃ vyākāsi, seyyathāpi bhavaṃ gotamo.
sn44.7:8.5: acchariyaṃ bho gotama, abbhutaṃ bho gotama,
sn44.7:8.6: yatra hi nāma satthussa ca sāvakassa ca atthenattho vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṃsandissati samessati na vihāyissati, yadidaṃ aggapadasminti.
